title: The Storage Room Murder
motive_summary: Isabella Reed was being blackmailed by Ben Carter over a secret ledger.
overview_text: 09:59 — Ben Carter, owner of Hobbs Cafe, found dead in the cafe storage room by Clara Wells. The cafe opened at 09:47. Several villagers passed nearby between 09:17 and 09:57. No one claims to have seen what happened. The morning can be rewound from 07:47.
